request.questionText: The owner of Borgin and Burkes, an antiquities and consignment shop, fits a linear model predicting daily sales revenue ($) from the number of customers who visit the store each day. The model equation is: If 70 customers visit the shop tomorrow, what is the daily sales revenue predicted by this model? Round your answer to the nearest dollar.
